purpose: Sanitized production preservation check after account foundation and failed-notification retry migrations
source: Read-only aggregate SQL; no user rows, emails, requests, picks, passwords or tokens exported

baselineComparison.difference: Only the seen_updates projection differs from the encrypted pre-account backup; every other preference field matches. This check does not attribute that update to a particular actor. No overwrite or rollback was performed.

digestMethods.picksNoSeparator: md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(p)::text,'' order by p.season,p.game_id,p.user_id),'')) from weekly_private.picks p
digestMethods.picksNewline: md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(p)::text,E'\n' order by to_jsonb(p)::text),'')) from weekly_private.picks p
digestMethods.players: md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(p)::text,E'\n' order by to_jsonb(p)::text),'')) from weekly_private.players p
digestMethods.preferences: md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(p)::text,'' order by p.user_id),'')) from public.my_team_preferences p
digestMethods.preferencesWithoutSeen: md5(coalesce(string_agg((to_jsonb(p)-'seen_updates')::text,'' order by p.user_id),'')) from public.my_team_preferences p
digestMethods.preferencesSeen: md5(coalesce(string_agg((to_jsonb(p)->'seen_updates')::text,'' order by p.user_id),'')) from public.my_team_preferences p
